source_document: California Preschool/Transitional Kindergarten Learning Foundations At-a-Glance
notes: CA uses an explicit 4-level hierarchy: Domain → Strand → Sub-Strand → Foundation. Side-by-side age columns ('Early (3 to 4 ½ Years)' vs. 'Later (4 to 5 ½ Years)') MUST each become a separate indicator.

elements.title: Curiosity and Interest
elements.description: Express interest in some familiar and new objects, people, and activities in their immediate environment. Seek information by exploring with their senses, describing their observations, and asking simple questions.

elements.title: Curiosity and Interest
elements.description: Express interest in a broader range of familiar and new objects, people, and activities by exploring more extensively with their senses, describing their observations in greater detail, and asking more detailed questions.

regression_cases.description: Side-by-side Early/Later columns under any Foundation must each emit their own indicator. Different code, same title, different age_band, different description.
regression_cases.assertion: for every Foundation N.N in the document, the detector output contains exactly 2 indicators: one with a code ending in '.EARLY' (age_band '36-54') and one ending in '.LATER' (age_band '54-60'), sharing the same base code and title but having distinct codes and distinct descriptions.

regression_cases.description: Age-band labels must never appear in the title field; they go to age_band.
regression_cases.assertion: no detected indicator has a title containing 'Early (' or 'Later ('.

regression_cases.description: The 'a.', 'b.', 'c.' lettered examples beneath a Foundation are not indicators.
regression_cases.assertion: no detected indicator's source_text starts with a lone single-letter prefix like 'a.', 'b.', 'c.' followed by an example fragment.

regression_cases.description: Every indicator must trace back through sub_strand → strand → domain.
regression_cases.assertion: for every indicator, sub_strand_code, strand_code, and domain_code in the parser output are non-null and resolve to existing elements.
